key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
AUD smashed on growth scare, compounding pressure on import-dependent sectors
Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway, hitting BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX materially
Oil prices exploded as suppression failed; fuel prices set to rise 30c/litre in Australia
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, raising further rate hike expectations
ANZ.AX axed 3,500 jobs; restructuring plan still faces long execution path
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy security fears; Santos preservation noted
Housing prices crashing at high end while affordable segment remains resilient; first-home buyer surge
Chinese inflation soaring, adding global demand uncertainty for commodity exporters
Mining cap raises accelerating (Canaccord-led), signalling capital stress in junior sector

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore bloodletting underway; oil surge benefits energy names but weighs on broad mining. Junior miners raising capital under duress. Gold steady but 'schmoulding' ahead of US inflation data.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore weakness. Oil beneficiaries (WDS.AX, WES.AX) may outperform. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) in wait-and-see mode. Cap raises dilute junior holders.

sectors.trend: Negative. Banks tumbling on rate-rise fears and growth scare. ANZ.AX restructuring (3,500 job cuts) signals cost pressure. RBA rental inflation concern implies further tightening, boosting NIM but risking credit losses.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face headwinds from growth scare and potential credit deterioration. Higher rates support NIM but housing correction risks mortgage defaults. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Positive for oil/gas. Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; Australian fuel prices rising 30c. Australia softened gas supply rules, easing Asian fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic priority.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WES.AX, S32.AX (Santos) benefit from oil surge and gas policy support. Higher fuel costs feed into inflation, complicating RBA path. LNG exporters (GAS.AX, WDS.AX) supported by Asian demand.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths (WES.AX) breached its own 'Price Freeze' on staples. Women's clothing chain closed 177 stores. Australian businesses fear for future. Fuel cost pass-through squeezing household budgets.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CPL.AX face margin and sentiment pressure. Consumer discretionary names under pressure. Cost-of-living squeeze may suppress retail sales data.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-negative. High-end property hit by steepest falls; affordable end resilient. RBA worried about rental inflation. Housing correction may have further to run. First-home buyer surge supports demand at lower end.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental yield pressure. Housing builders (MTP.AX, PNC.AX) may see volume support from first-home buyers. High-end REITs underperform.

sectors.trend: Neutral-to-positive. Proton therapy project in Australia faces alternate plans. HIVE.AX (BUZZ HPC) scaling AI cloud with enterprise veteran. Critical Resources battery tech holding firm in testing.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. HIVE.AX, CRB.AX offer thematic exposure to AI and battery tech. Proton therapy delays may affect medical device names.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears and RBA rental inflation concern driving bond yields higher, pressuring growth equities
Commodity divergence: iron ore weak, oil strong, gold cautious
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and inflation risk
Mining sector capital stress: cap raises and restructuring
Housing market bifurcation: high-end correction vs affordable resilience
Geopolitical risk: German election, UK sanctions, India summit, Chinese Arctic shipping
Superannuation policy debate intensifying with populist pressure
Chinese inflation surge threatening global demand outlook

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA further rate hikes on rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce leverage; favour fixed-income and dividend-paying defensives
Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into oil/gas and gold hedges
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor AUD/USD closely
Avoid high-end REITs; monitor credit data; favour affordable-segment builders

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Germany election, sanctions, India summit)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain gold allocation; diversify geographically; monitor commodity supply chains
Avoid junior miners with imminent cap raises; focus on cash-flow-positive majors

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight oil and gas names on oil price surge and gas policy support
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; Australia softened gas rules; fuel prices rising 30c supports upstream margins

opportunities.recommendation: Add gold as inflation and geopolitical hedge
opportunities.rationale: Gold steady ahead of US inflation data; AUD weakness supports gold miners; geopolitical risk elevated

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to AI/tech and battery tech
opportunities.rationale: HIVE.AX scaling AI cloud; Critical Resources battery tech holding firm; secular growth themes

opportunities.recommendation: Favour affordable-segment housing builders on first-home buyer surge
opportunities.rationale: Housing bifurcation: high-end correcting but affordable end resilient; policy support for first-home buyers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and broad mining exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting underway; Chinese inflation signals demand weakness; cap raises signal capital stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank exposure pending credit data
defensive_moves.rationale: Growth scare and housing correction risk credit losses; ANZ restructuring signals sector-wide cost pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce consumer discretionary
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; fuel costs rising; Woolworths price breach signals margin pressure; retail weakness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate-rise fears and 90bn ASX drawdown suggest further volatility; defensive positioning prudent

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend losses as rate-rise fears, iron ore weakness, and AUD depreciation persist. Oil surge provides partial offset for energy names. Expect elevated volatility into RBA commentary and US inflation data. 90bn drawdown signals sentiment reset.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may create entry points in 6-12 months. Oil/gas structural support from policy. AI and battery tech offer secular growth. Key risk is prolonged global slowdown from Chinese inflation and geopolitical fragmentation.
